directive_basis: R404 item 10: current maturity -> next experiment -> expected information gain -> evidence required -> commercial state after PASS -> commercial state after FAIL. The bridge between scientific truth and technology transfer.

chain.current_maturity: ENGINEERING_DEFINED: simulation chain archived and hash-pinned (fluence 1.0-1.4 mW/cm², three model anchors), CAD valid (receiver 38.4845 mm² independently re-measured), D1 reconciled, canonical deliverable power UNKNOWN (eta unknown), D2 engineering gap OPEN (500 µW target vs 121-163 µW conditional band), zero physical validation
chain.next_experiment: Prerequisite owner ENGINEERING DECISION — now an explicit gate: D2_OWNER_DECISION_GATE.json (options: target revision / receiver enlargement / source-power increase with the UNKNOWN thermal ceiling / hybrid; eta alone can never close it); then the phantom-path bench experiment (DECISIVE_EXPERIMENT.json): tissue-equivalent path + the same GaAs receiver vs free-space control, reference photodiode + IV curves + thermal probes
chain.expected_information_gain: Converts the package's entire quantitative basis (fluence, efficiency, thermal) from simulation-archived to physically measured in one bench protocol — and the falsifier's routing rule (in-band measurement = chain confirmed + D2 relocation) means the experiment is decisive BOTH ways: it can kill the mechanism (thermal/fluence failure) or validate the chain and force the target/area decision
chain.evidence_required: Measured phantom-path fluence vs the archived band; measured low-irradiance cell efficiency (the UNKNOWN input); measured thermal envelope at the source power the measurement implies
chain.commercial_state_after_PASS: The recorded chain survives its first physical confrontation; D2 becomes a concrete engineering program (area growth ×4.3, source fluence, or target revision) that a sponsor can price; TRANSFER advances on evidence
chain.commercial_state_after_FAIL: Thermal infeasibility or fluence far below the band kills the mechanism (per the falsifier) — the package enters the cemetery with the optical-chain lesson codified; partial failures (efficiency collapse only) route to component repair, recorded exactly so
